# Agenda cases over work.org and home.org (the agenda files, in that
# order), default settings, "now" = 2026-10-01 Thu 12:00, width 80.
#   <name> agenda <span> <start-date>
#   <name> log <span> <start-date>        (agenda with log mode on)
#   <name> todo <keywords|->              (org-todo-list; - = all)
#   <name> tags <match>                   (org-tags-view)
#   <name> tags-todo <match>              (org-tags-view, TODO only)
#   <name> search <words>                 (org-search-view)
day         agenda     day   2026-10-01
day-past    agenda     day   2026-09-29
day-future  agenda     day   2026-10-03
week        agenda     week  2026-10-01
log-day     log        day   2026-10-01
todo        todo       -
todo-kw     todo       WAITING|NEXT
tags        tags       +work
tags-or     tags       work|personal
tags-not    tags       -work+TODO="TODO"
tags-prop   tags       CATEGORY="chores"
tags-todo   tags-todo  +work|+home
search      search     task
